description: This PHP source file defines the 'AOK_KnowledgeBaseDashlet' class, which extends the 'DashletGeneric' class. It is part of a SuiteCRM module, responsible for displaying a dashlet related to the AOK_KnowledgeBase module. The file includes necessary dependencies, defines the class constructor, and sets up dashlet configurations such as title, search fields, and columns.
